data.name: Alien Farmer
data.detailed_description:
Build Your Base

Design and expand your farm on a hostile alien planet. Place structures, manage farm, and plan efficient layouts to support both production and defense. Your base is the heart of your survival.

Grow Plants

Cultivate crops to sustain your health and fond research. Grow plants and harvest them to exchange for galactic coin and explore new blueprints. Balance growth, space, and resources to keep your operation running. Farming is essential to long-term survival.

Mine Resources

Extract valuable minerals from the planet’s surface and depths. Mining provides the raw materials needed for construction, crafting, and automation. Every expansion starts with the ground beneath your feet.

Automate Your Jobs

Set up automated systems using drones and robots. Optimize workflows to reduce manual labor and increase efficiency. Smart automation keeps your colony alive as threats grow stronger.

Interact with Alien Life

Encounter mysterious alien creatures and ecosystems. Some may be passive, others hostile, and all are part of the planet’s living world. Use them to grow new alien plant species. Your choices shape how you survive alongside them.

Defend Your Base

When night falls, danger emerges. Build defenses, automated turrets, deploy mechs and prepare for relentless alien attacks. Survival depends on how well you protect what you’ve built.

Explore (Alone or Co-op)

Venture across the planet’s dangerous landscapes alone or with friends. Discover new areas, resources, and threats together. Cooperation is key to pushing deeper into the unknown. You can use robots for companion too.

data.short_description: Alien Farmer is a farming, light automation, tower defense game set on a hostile alien world. Farm, mine, and build an automated base by day, then defend it against deadly creatures by night. Explore, expand, and survive alone or in co-op.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
